title: When the West Wind Arises
description: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius...

mainQuestExcel.title: When the West Wind Arises
mainQuestExcel.description: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius...

flow.stepDescription: Talk to Sara about her problem

dialogs.text: Is something wrong, Sara?
Sorry, I already ate.
Ah, finally, I caught you!
Oh, I'm not after your patronage.
I have something I'd like the Knights of Favonius to do for me, and I want you to pass on my request to the Acting Grand Master.
Oh, so it's Jean you were really hoping to see.
We're like peas in a pod.
We've met.
I'm her loyal slave.
You are close with her?
Really? It must be a good feeling knowing Jean's got your back.
Well, I heard she has a lot of respect for you.
Slave!? I never knew that such antiquated and aristocratic practices existed in the Knights of Favonius!
#Ahem, sorry, {NICKNAME} just has a weird sense of humor.
...Anyway, what was it you wanted us to tell Jean?
Oh yes... I must apologize for being unable to visit the Knights in person, but the restaurant has been so busy lately.
Unfortunately, it's right in this busy season that the route between here and Springvale, which is used for the delivery of our ingredients, seems to have been occupied by the hilichurls.
So you want the Knights to clear the road.
So you want someone to teach those hunters a lesson.
The problem is that the suppliers in Springvale say that deliveries have nothing to do with them, they're just responsible for selling us the ingredients.
That would be great.
What? No! How is that going to help!?
Sure.
Please <color=#00E1FFFF>ask Master Jean</color> to send a party to clear out the hilichurls from the road to Springvale.
Phew, help at last. With Jean on the case, this'll be solved in no time. Thank you.
Seems like everyone really trusts Jean.
Oh, I nearly forgot. <color=#00E1FFFF>Charles the bartender</color> said he's been having some trouble, too.
Why don't you stop by and see him on the way?
Fine. In for a penny, in for a pound is the Paimon way... but this is really stretching the definition of "on the way" in my opinion.
The customers are getting hungry. Please be quick.
What do you think this is, kiddo, a fruit juice store?
Hmph. How rude! Especially since we're here to HELP!
Help? Oh yes, you're the Acting Grand Master's new hotshot helper, aren't you?
Uh... That's one way of putting it, but—
Great. Tell Jean I need my quarterly tax return forms then.
It's time to get Elzer onto doing the accounts again... I must say though, the tax rate on alcohol in Mondstadt is pretty steep.
Do you really need to get Jean involved with stuff like this?
And yet the Dawn Winery is somehow so very rich.
That's mostly down to Master Diluc's successful business model.
Why are the accounts with Jean? Does she do bookkeeping now too?
Acting Grand Master Jean personally goes over all the accounts.
After all, the wine industry is Mondstadt's main source of income. Jean takes great pains to make sure no detail is overlooked.
Paimon never knew that. Jean's job is even harder than it seems.
The Acting Grand Master's hard work indeed makes our lives a whole lot easier.
We're certainly very lucky, but... to put it bluntly, we just take it for granted that that's the norm now.
Wow... How do you sleep at night knowing how much pressure you put Jean under?
*sigh* When you put it like that I do feel quite ashamed... I suppose I should give her one on the house next time she's here.
Although... I doubt the Acting Grand Master even has the time to spare for that.
Sounds like a poor excuse to deny Jean a free drink...
#Come on {NICKNAME}, let's <color=#00E1FFFF>go and see Jean</color>.
Jean's overworked? Yes, relatively speaking you guys have a lot more time on your hands.

flow.stepDescription: Pass the citizens' commissions on to Jean

dialogs.text: Hey, you two!
Margaret! What are you doing here?
My cat's gone missing. Have you seen it?
No.
You mean... Diona?
No, not her. I imagine Diona's probably still in the tavern.
I mean little Princey. Prince was just home, now he's gone.
Did you seriously think Diona was a house cat!?
This is a bit worrying. What if Prince can't find his way home?
I would love to help, but...
But we are on our way to an urgent meeting with Jean. Sorry.
I guess we can have a look for your cat.
#Naw, {NICKNAME}. You're always such a big softie. But aren't we in the middle of something?
Sara and Charles need our help urgently, too. Let's go and see Jean first.
You're on the way to see Jean? What a coincidence.
Paimon thought you were looking for a cat?
Yes, I wanted to see if Jean could help look for my cat.
Seriously? You want Jean... to help you look for your cat?
What's wrong with that?
Jean's a really nice person.
Such a solid line of reasoning...
I feel like this is a classic case of "good people finish last."
Please mention it to Jean for me. I'll treat you to a brew at Cat's Tail later.
Hey, HEY!
Ugh, unbelievable! Guess the case of Prince the missing cat is now added to the agenda for our meeting with Jean.
Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. It's a black cat you're looking for.
*cough*...
Acting Grand Master—
Oh, ahh— Master Jean?
...Master Jean?
Hey, Jean? Jeany Jean-Jean?
...Behold, the Dandelion Knight herself?
Oh! It's our Honorary Knight. Sorry, I must have been daydreaming.
How can I assist?
Actually, it's not us who need your help. It's a bunch of other people...
I see. Well, thank you for your service to the people of Mondstadt. *cough*
I have made a note of these commissions in my files and I will... make arrangements...
...accordingly.
Great.
We didn't miss out anyone's commissions, did we?
Sara's hilichurls, Charles' tax return, Margaret's cat... Seems that's everything.
We'll be on our way then, Jean— Jean?
Jean! Are you okay!?
How's Jean holding up? Is it serious?
It's just burnout from work stress. She'll be fine after a good old rest.
Thanks for bringing her here — she may have tried to keep soldiering on otherwise.
It's not a surprise though, she does have a lot to get through every day.
Poor Jean. She has always been one to push herself too hard while overlooking her own needs.
This isn't the first time something like this has happened.
She really has it tough doesn't she. Poor Jean.
Seems like you really care about Jean.
Oh, ah... You think so? I—I mean, she's the Acting Grand Master and all, we can't have her collapsing all the time now can we...
S—So y'know, it's not like this is a personal... thing, it's just out of love for— concern for... the greater good! Yes, that's it!
What's up with Barbara... Weird~
#...Anyway, you're an honorary knight, aren't you {NICKNAME}?
While the Master is down, the knights should share her burden, no?
That's a very good point, but... Shouldn't one of the fully-qualified knights do that?
Jean has so much to do, an extra pair of hands can't hurt.
You should go and check in at the <color=#00E1FFFF>headquarters</color>. Jean will be fine with just me here.
Paimon feels like she's trying to get rid of us...
Hmm?
#Nothing! We'll leave you to it — come on {NICKNAME}, let's go.

flow.stepDescription: Return to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogs.text: I already told you, I can take care of Jean on my own. Please help Jean out by completing her tasks.
Oh, it's Kaeya.
I've been waiting for you.
I have been informed about Jean falling ill. On behalf of all of the Knights of Favonius, allow me to express my sincere gratitude for your assistance.
So courteous and polite. This isn't the Kaeya Paimon knows.
Haha... Well, the circumstances warrant it. This is the Acting Grand Master herself we're talking about.
Now, in addition to that thank-you message, there was one other thing...
You have a job for us?
It's like you read my mind! We have quite a connection, don't you think?
Is this the part where you give us our reward?
Hahaha. I must say I like your style.
But before we can discuss a reward, there are some things I hope you can assist the Knights with.
Things like helping to fill in for Jean?
Right. Although the commissions you reported to Jean have already been handed off to someone else...
...I am concerned that they will not be handled with due care without Jean's personal touch.
So I am hoping that you can help out where you see fit.
I will feel much more at ease knowing that the Honorary Knight is personally overseeing these cases.
#You can flatter {NICKNAME} all you want, but answer me this — why don't YOU do it!?
Haha... Oh, I have far more important matters to attend to. There are so many things to... to prepare.
Hmph. Fine then. So it's <color=#00E1FFFF>Sara, Charles and Margaret's</color> stuff you want us to help with, right?
Those are the ones. I appreciate the help. See you later!

flow.stepDescription: Find Margaret and ask about the commission
Find Charles and ask about the commission
Find Sara and ask about the commission
